Name: Matching Tools - Iridium Pan and hat
Author: Wumbuzz
Description:
You grinded hard for all your tools and weapons to be iridium but the Copper Pan is messing up your color scheme?
This mod replaces the Copper Pan with an [b]Iridium Pan[/b] to match the other Tools and Weapons.
It also replaces the "Copper Pan hat" with an Iridium Pan hat if you wear the pan on your head [b][i]Hey, you look dashing! [/i][/b]

...


That's it. It turns the Copper Pan into a cool iridium-purple. [b]Aesthetic! ✨


[/b]If you want your Golden Scythe to match as well, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10560]Matching Tools - Iridium Scythe[/url].


[u][b]Troubleshooting
[/b][/u]

[b]Q: My Pan looks Iridium, but the description still says "Copper Pan"![/b]
[b]A:[/b] Unfortunately, it's only possible to change the name when you install this mod [b][u]before[/u][/b] acquiring the Copper Pan. If you install the mod while already owning the Copper, the item description will still call it "Copper Pan". But hey, look at that fancy purple color!
